title: Launch & Orbit Bench
learning_goals: Calculate multi-stage rocket mass budgets and Tsiolkovsky delta-v.
Ensure liftoff thrust-to-weight ratio (TWR > 1.0) and verify stage propellant capacities.
Execute preflight diagnostic checklists and obtain range safety clearance.
Achieve stable low Earth orbit (LEO) insertion with minimal ascent gravity and steering losses.
Execute Hohmann transfer burns and circularization at target orbital altitudes.
Debrief flight telemetry and verify Keplerian energy conservation.

rules.text: Flight computer checklist and guidance diagnostics must be run prior to launch.
rules.hint: Execute preflight avionics and telemetry checklist before clearance requests.

rules.text: Propellant load must not be empty or exceed maximum certified tank capacity.
rules.hint: Load propellant within maximum structural capacity of tank stages.

rules.text: Liftoff thrust-to-weight ratio must exceed 1.0 (TWR > 1.0) to achieve positive climb acceleration.
rules.hint: Maintain liftoff Thrust-to-Weight Ratio above 1.15 to clear launch pad.

rules.text: Payload mass must be formally declared and within upper stage structural limits.
rules.hint: Ensure payload mass remains strictly within launch vehicle LEO insertion limits.

rules.text: Lower booster stage burnout required before staging separation and upper stage ignition.
rules.hint: Separate depleted booster stage only after complete engine burnout.

rules.text: Range safety radar tracking and downrange airspace clearance required before ignition.
rules.hint: Obtain positive range safety tracking clearance prior to main engine ignition.

rules.text: Trajectory budget must maintain at least a 5% delta-v reserve margin to avoid orbital decay.
rules.hint: Achieve minimum orbital delta-v budget (9.3 km/s) for stable orbital insertion.

rules.text: Telemetry review and flight debrief must be completed before submitting final flight report.
rules.hint: Debrief flight computer telemetry before generating final mission report.

choose_rocket: Select an orbital launch vehicle configuration (e.g. Orbis 1 or Orbis Heavy).
declare_payload: Specify mission payload mass (kg) within vehicle capacity.
fuel_rocket: Load propellant into launch vehicle stages according to capacity limits.
run_checklist: Execute preflight flight computer diagnostic checklist.
clear_range: Confirm range safety clearance with tracking and range control.
launch: Ignite stage 1 and launch vehicle to reach orbital insertion altitude.
coast: Coast to parking orbit apoapsis or transfer point.
burn_transfer: Execute apogee or Hohmann transfer burn to target orbit altitude.
circularize: Execute final circularization burn to achieve target circular orbit.
debrief: Analyze orbital telemetry and flight parameters before final sign-off.

common_mistakes.remedy: Obtain range safety clearance and run preflight checklist before ignition.
Ensure booster stage thrust exceeds total wet vehicle weight (TWR > 1.0).
